data:
The plugin ships a persistent BLE GATT control channel for robot
teleoperation, alongside the existing MQTT and WebRTC DataChannel transports.
It implements the same TeleopChannel interface, so it drops straight into
RobotController (and DualTeleopChannel) — the watchdog, epoch gating and
keepalive are identical; only the transport changes.
This is not the BLE provisioning path (EspBleProvisioningChannel).
Provisioning is a one-shot Wi-Fi handoff; the teleop channel is a long-lived
link that carries commands and telemetry continuously.
data.gatt-contract#GATT contract:
The robot firmware must expose one service with two characteristics (defaults
below; override via the constructors if your firmware already reserves other
UUIDs):
Role	UUID	Direction	Use	Service	7e4e1700-cb3e-4b5f-9b2a-1c6e8d3f4a5b	—	Teleop service	Command	…1701… (same base)	phone → device, write	JSON command	Telemetry	…1702… (same base)	device → phone, notify	JSON telemetry
data.command-envelope#Command envelope:
The phone writes one JSON object per command:
type	Fields	velocity	linear, angular	ptz	pan, tilt, zoom?	stop	—
data.telemetry-envelope#Telemetry envelope:
The device notifies a JSON object parsed by RobotTelemetry (it tolerates
linearSpeed/v, angularSpeed/w, battery, pose, online).
data.resilience#Resilience:
FlutterBluePlusBleLink auto-reconnects on a drop (capped attempts,
exponential backoff), so a brief BLE glitch never silently kills the link. A
drop still trips the RobotController watchdog if it outlasts
watchdogTimeout, so the robot always stops on a real loss of control.

data.nfc-tags-and-dpp#NFC tags and DPP:
An NFC tag carries credentials only — reading it never provisions a device,
so readNfcCredential() returns the credentials and leaves the delivery to you:
final wifi = await provisioning.readNfcCredential();  // tag only, no device
await provisioning.provisionViaBle(device, wifi!);    // deliver it over BLE
await provisioning.provisionViaNfc(device: device);   // or read + deliver
DPP needs the device's bootstrap URI (DPP:…), not its id: fill
ProvisionDevice.dppUri from the scanned QR code, otherwise the call is
rejected with protocolMismatch instead of failing opaquely inside the system
configurator.
final device = ProvisionDevice(id: id, name: name, dppUri: scannedQr);
await provisioning.provision(device, wifi: wifi, method: ProvisionMethod.dpp);
data.ota#OTA:
OtaUpdater(channel: bleChannel)
    .upgrade(
      deviceId: device.id,
      firmwareUrl: signedUrl,
      expectedSha256: sha256,
    )
    .listen((p) => debugPrint('${p.percent} %'));
:::warning
Do not trust the device's "success" flag. Trust the version it reports
afterwards. The plugin keeps the update stream, retries, and leaves the
verdict to the reported version.
:::Rollback is a device-side concern (dual partitions); the app only transfers the
image and displays state.

data.do-i-need-a-server#Do I need a server?:
Yes. The plugin is client-side only. For WHIP/WHEP use SRS, ZLMediaKit or
MediaMTX; for rooms use a LiveKit server. For anything custom, implement
RtcSignaling / RtcSession.
data.do-i-really-need-turn#Do I really need T:
For anything outside your own LAN: yes. Camera and robot NATs are frequently
symmetric or behind CGNAT, where STUN alone cannot punch through. RelayPlanner
will escalate to RelayMode.forced after relayAfterAttempts failed attempts.
data.why-does-clarity-switching-fail-on-my-ca:
Because it publishes a single layer. There is no software clarity switch on a
single-layer stream. Either transcode server-side or publish main/sub streams as
separate stream ids (_sd / _hd / _fhd), which the plugin will switch
between (expect a 1–2 s blink).
data.why-is-my-video-frozen-while-the-ui-says:
ICE state is not media state. MediaHealthMonitor exists precisely for this: it
classifies frozen from stats and escalates to a keyframe request and then a
re-subscribe. Render LinkPhase.degraded as a warning, never as "connected".
data.why-does-the-plugin-rebuild-the-peer-con:
WHIP/WHEP (RFC 9725) forbids renegotiation after the initial SDP, so an ICE
restart is expressed as a fresh peer connection with a fresh ICE configuration.
Track changes never do this — they use replaceTrack.
data.why-must-i-confirm-a-resume#Why must I c:
Because the alternative is dangerous. Commands captured before the interruption
(a joystick pushed left while the app was backgrounded) are no longer valid when
the link returns. PauseResumeGate bumps an epoch on every pause so those
operations are dropped, and requires an explicit confirmation to start a new
epoch.
data.can-i-disable-the-pauseresume-flow#Can I:
You can pass no gate (legacy behaviour) or call
resumeImmediately(afterReconnect: true) in a custom policy. Both are explicit
opt-outs; neither is the default.
data.why-is-my-ble-provisioning-dependency-di:
esp_provisioning_ble pins protobuf ^3, which conflicts with
livekit_client's protobuf ^4/^6. The plugin implements protocomm Security1
directly (lib/src/device/protocomm.dart) with cryptography, so no protobuf
dependency remains.
data.ios-can-i-use-nfc-tap-to-provision#iOS::
Read-only, and only with the entitlement
com.apple.developer.nfc.readersession.formats — which requires a paid account
and an explicit App ID (no wildcards). iOS cannot emulate tags (HCE).
data.ios-can-the-app-connect-to-a-device-hots: No. Apple forbids programmatic Wi-Fi joining. Guide the user to Settings.
data.android-14-why-does-background-audio-cra:
Missing FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE and
foregroundServiceType="microphone". Android throws SecurityException at
service start. The plugin ships RtcLinkForegroundService and merges the
declaration.
data.can-i-test-on-a-simulator#Can I test on:
Only UI and logic. iOS Simulator has no camera, NFC or Bluetooth; the Android
emulator cannot do BLE, NFC or SoftAP. Device management needs real hardware.

data:
Real-time audio/video (WebRTC) and IoT device management in one Flutter plugin:
publish and subscribe with two interchangeable engines, switch clarity per
stream, relay a live stream, teleoperate a robot over a low-latency control
link, provision / update / diagnose devices — plus a resilience layer built for
overseas, cross-public-network links.Version: 0.4.0 · License: MPL-2.0 · Platforms: Android, iOS
data.three-channels-never-mixed#Three channel:
media    WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP or LiveKit)   video / audio / screen
control  MQTT or DataChannel             teleoperation, PTZ, telemetry, device signaling
business HTTPS                           tokens, device binding, OTA distribution, reports
Each channel degrades independently. When the network degrades, video goes
first, audio second, control commands last.
data.two-engines-one-abstraction#Two engines,:
WHIP/WHEP engine	LiveKit engine	Backing package	flutter_webrtc	livekit_client	Best for	Self-hosted SRS / ZLMediaKit / MediaMTX, IoT camera playback	Interactive rooms, co-hosting, large audiences	Signaling	HTTP (RFC 9725)	LiveKit server + JWT	Renegotiation	Forbidden — use replaceTrack, rebuild on ICE restart	Allowed	
Both expose the same surface: RtcEngine → RtcSession → LocalPublisher /
RemoteSubscriber, plus a shared RtcEvent stream and RtcStats.
data.what-is-in-the-box#What is in the box: Area	Entry point	Publishing (camera / mic / screen, simulcast)	LocalPublisher	Subscribing and clarity switching	RemoteSubscriber, VideoGridController	Live relay and role transfer	RoleTransfer, StreamRelay	Robot teleoperation	RobotController, TeleopChannel	Device provisioning, OTA, logs, diagnostics	DeviceProvisioning, OtaUpdater, DeviceLogCollector, Diagnostics	Permissions	RtcPermissions	Resilience (overseas, handover, weak network, background)	ResilientSession, RelayPlanner, NetworkPathMonitor, MediaHealthMonitor, PauseResumeGate
data.start-here#Start here:
Installation — add the dependency and the platform setup.
Quick Start — your first publish/subscribe loop.
Resilience — read this before shipping outside a LAN.
Robot Teleoperation — joystick, watchdog and the pause/resume flow.
Devices — provisioning, OTA, logs, diagnostics.
FAQ — common questions and platform caveats.
Chinese documentation lives under /zh.

data.from-github#From GitHub:
dependencies:
  flutter_rtc_link:
    git:
      url: https://github.com/zero-labsco/flutter_rtc_link.git
      ref: release/v0.4.0
data.import#Import:
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link.dart'; // media core
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link_device.dart'; // provisioning, OTA, logs
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link_robot.dart'; // teleoperation
Import only the modules you actually use: the media core, device management and
robot teleoperation are independent entry points. Everything public is
re-exported from one of these three files; never import lib/src/... directly.
data.requirements#Requirements: Requirement	Version	Flutter	>= 3.35.0	Dart SDK	>= 3.9.0 < 4.0.0	Android	minSdk 24, compileSdk 36+	iOS	15.0+
data.android-setup#Android setup:
The plugin merges these into the host manifest, so you normally add nothing:
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT" />
<uses-permission
    android:name="android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES"
    android:usesPermissionFlags="neverForLocation" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.hardware.nfc" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE" />
:::warning
Android 14+ (API 34+) throws SecurityException at service start unless the
microphone foreground service is declared. The plugin ships
RtcLinkForegroundService for exactly this case.
:::
data.ios-setup#iOS setup:
Usage strings cannot be injected by the plugin — add every one you use to
ios/Runner/Info.plist:
<key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key>
<string>Camera access is required to publish video.</string>
<key>NSMicrophoneUsageDescription</key>
<string>Microphone access is required to publish audio.</string>
<key>NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription</key>
<string>Bluetooth is used to provision and update devices.</string>
<key>NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription</key>
<string>Local network access is used to discover devices.</string>
<key>NFCReaderUsageDescription</key>
<string>NFC is used for tap-to-provision.</string>
<key>UIBackgroundModes</key>
<array>
  <string>audio</string>
</array>
NFC additionally requires the entitlement
com.apple.developer.nfc.readersession.formats (paid account, explicit App ID).
data.next-steps#Next steps:
Quick Start
Resilience — required reading for public-internet deployments

data.switching-sources-without-renegotiation#:
WHIP (RFC 9725) forbids changing media sections after the initial SDP, so the
plugin never renegotiates. Track changes use replaceTrack:
await publisher.switchCamera(facing: CameraFacing.front);   // no ICE, no SDP
await publisher.startScreenShare();                          // adds a sender once
await publisher.stopScreenShare();                           // back to the camera
:::tip
Keep the sender alive and only swap the track. Creating and closing senders on
every switch is what causes "one second of black video" on WHIP servers.
:::
data.simulcast#Simulcast:
Publishing always opens simulcast layers when the server supports them:
maxClarity	Layers published	p2160	2160p / 1080p / 540p	p1080	1080p / 720p / 360p	p720	720p / 360p	p360	360p	
setPublishClarity only raises or lowers the top layer; lower layers stay
available, so subscribers on slow links are never punished by the publisher's
choice.
await publisher.setPublishClarity(ClarityLevel.p720); // cap, do not restart
data.leaving-the-session#Leaving the session:
await publisher.stop();  // stops tracks, keeps the session alive
await session.leave();   // tears the whole thing down

data.5-make-it-survive-the-real-world#5. Make:
One more line turns the session into a supervised, self-healing link:
final resilient = await ResilientSession.connect(
  roomId: 'robot-42',
  role: RtcRole.robotOperator,
  factory: engine.join,
  config: ResilientSessionConfig(
    relay: RelayPlanner(servers: iceServers),
    monitor: CallbackNetworkMonitor(),
  ),
);
See Resilience for the full picture.
data.leaving#Leaving:
await resilient.dispose(); // or await session.leave();
await engine.dispose();

data.switching-clarity#Switching clarity:
await remote.setClarity(ClarityLevel.p540);   // this stream only
await session.unsubscribe('robot-42');
Engine	Single-layer stream	Multi-layer / variants	LiveKit	videoQuality maps directly	Layer selection is native	WHIP/WHEP	No software switch — the plugin switches to the variant stream id (_sd / _hd / _fhd, 1–2 s blink) or reports claritySwitchUnsupported	SDP rid layer selection	
:::warning
A single-layer stream has no software clarity switch. Either transcode
server-side (ZLMediaKit) or expose main/sub streams as separate stream ids —
the plugin never pretends otherwise.
:::
data.auto-quality#Auto quality:
auto follows RtcStats: available bandwidth, packet loss and RTT drive the
layer up or down, and remote.clarity.value always reflects the actual
current level, so the UI never lies.

data:
插件在既有的 MQTT 与 WebRTC DataChannel 之外，额外提供了一条基于 BLE GATT 的
持久控制通道，用于机器人遥操作。它实现的是同一个 TeleopChannel 接口，因此可
直接接入 RobotController（与 DualTeleopChannel）——看门狗、epoch 门控与保活
行为完全一致，只是传输变了。
这不是 BLE 配网 通道（EspBleProvisioningChannel）。配网是一次性 Wi-Fi
交接；本通道是一条长期存活的链路，持续搬运指令与遥测。
data.gatt-契约#GATT 契约:
机器人固件须暴露一个包含两个特征的服务（以下为默认值；若固件已占用其它 UUID，
可通过构造参数覆盖）：
角色	UUID	方向	用途	服务	7e4e1700-cb3e-4b5f-9b2a-1c6e8d3f4a5b	—	遥测服务	指令	…1701…（同基准）	手机 → 设备，可写	JSON 指令	遥测	…1702…（同基准）	设备 → 手机，notify	JSON 遥测
data.指令封包#指令封包:
手机每次写入一个 JSON 对象：
type	字段	velocity	linear、angular	ptz	pan、tilt、zoom?	stop	—
data.遥测封包#遥测封包:
设备 notify 一个 JSON 对象，由 RobotTelemetry 解析（兼容
linearSpeed/v、angularSpeed/w、battery、pose、online）。
data.韧性#韧性:
FlutterBluePlusBleLink 在断线后自动重连（有上限、指数退避），短暂的 BLE
抖动不会悄悄掐断链路。但若断线超过 watchdogTimeout，仍会触发 RobotController
的看门狗，确保机器人在真正失控时一定停车。

data.nfc-标签与-dpp#NFC 标签与 DPP:
NFC 标签只携带凭据，读到它并不等于设备已配网；readNfcCredential() 只返回
凭据，下发仍由你决定：
final wifi = await provisioning.readNfcCredential();  // 只读标签，不涉及设备
await provisioning.provisionViaBle(device, wifi!);    // 经 BLE 下发
await provisioning.provisionViaNfc(device: device);   // 或读取 + 下发一步完成
DPP 需要设备的引导 URI（DPP:…）而不是设备 id：把扫到的二维码填进
ProvisionDevice.dppUri，否则调用会以 protocolMismatch 被拒绝，而不是在系统
配置器里不明原因地失败。
final device = ProvisionDevice(id: id, name: name, dppUri: scannedQr);
await provisioning.provision(device, wifi: wifi, method: ProvisionMethod.dpp);
data.ota#OTA:
OtaUpdater(channel: bleChannel)
    .upgrade(
      deviceId: device.id,
      firmwareUrl: signedUrl,
      expectedSha256: sha256,
    )
    .listen((p) => debugPrint('${p.percent} %'));
:::warning
不要相信设备返回的"成功"标志，相信它随后上报的版本号。插件只负责传输与状态
展示，判定交给版本号。
:::回滚属于设备端职责（双分区），App 只负责传输与展示。

data.需要自己搭服务器吗#需要自己搭服务器吗？:
需要。插件只做客户端。WHIP/WHEP 用 SRS、ZLMediaKit 或 MediaMTX；房间语义用
LiveKit 服务端；自建则实现 RtcSignaling / RtcSession。
data.一定要部署-turn-吗#一定要部署 TURN 吗？:
只要出了自己的局域网，就必须。摄像头与机器人的 NAT 常常是对称型或在 CGNAT 之后，
单靠 STUN 打不通。RelayPlanner 会在直连失败 relayAfterAttempts 次后升级到
RelayMode.forced。
data.为什么我的摄像头切不了清晰度#为什么我的摄像头切不了清晰度？:
因为它只推单层码流，单层流没有软件清晰度切换能力。要么服务端转码，要么把主/子码流
发布成不同 stream id（_sd / _hd / _fhd），插件会在其间切换（有 1~2s 闪断）。
data.为什么-ui-显示已连接但画面是冻结的#为什么 UI 显示\"已连接\"但画面是:
ICE 状态不等于媒体状态。这正是 MediaHealthMonitor 存在的意义：它从 stats 判定
frozen，并逐级升级到请求关键帧、重建订阅。LinkPhase.degraded 必须渲染为告警，
不能显示成"已连接"。
data.为什么切网时插件要重建-peer-connection#为什么切网时插件要重建:
WHIP/WHEP（RFC 9725）禁止在初始 SDP 之后重协商，因此 ICE 重启只能表达为"用全新
ICE 配置重建连接"。换轨道不走这条路——它用 replaceTrack。
data.为什么恢复必须由人确认#为什么恢复必须由人确认？:
因为不确认会有危险。中断前采集到的指令（比如应用后台期间摇杆被推到左边），在链路
恢复时已经不再有效。PauseResumeGate 在每次暂停时递增 epoch，让这些操作失效，并
要求显式确认才能开启新的 epoch。
data.可以关掉暂停--恢复流程吗#可以关掉暂停 / 恢复流程吗？:
可以不传 gate（退回旧行为），或在自定义策略中调用
resumeImmediately(afterReconnect: true)。两者都是显式退出，且都不是默认行为。
data.为什么-ble-配网没有用官方-esp-包#为什么 BLE 配网没有用官方 ES:
esp_provisioning_ble 锁定 protobuf ^3，与 livekit_client 的
protobuf ^4/^6 冲突。插件直接用 cryptography 实现了 protocomm Security1
（lib/src/device/protocomm.dart），彻底移除该依赖。
data.ios-能用-nfc-碰一碰配网吗#iOS 能用 NFC 碰一碰配网吗？:
只能读，且需要 entitlement
com.apple.developer.nfc.readersession.formats（付费账号 + 显式 App ID，不支持
通配符）。iOS 不能模拟标签（HCE）。
data.ios-能自动连设备热点吗#iOS 能自动连设备热点吗？: 不能。Apple 禁止程序化加入 Wi-Fi，只能引导用户去设置页操作。
data.android-14-后台录音为什么崩#Android 14 后台录音为什么崩？:
缺 FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE 与 foregroundServiceType="microphone"，
Android 会在启动服务时抛 SecurityException。插件已内置
RtcLinkForegroundService 并合并声明。
data.模拟器能测吗#模拟器能测吗？:
只能测 UI 与逻辑。iOS 模拟器没有摄像头 / NFC / 蓝牙；Android 模拟器无法做 BLE、
NFC 与 SoftAP。设备管理能力必须有真机。
data.英文文档在哪#英文文档在哪？: 站点根路径（可返回 English。

data:
一个插件同时做实时音视频（WebRTC）与物联网设备管理：双引擎可互换地推流与订阅、
按流切换清晰度、直播转接、通过低时延控制链路遥控机器人、设备配网 / 升级 / 诊断，
并内置面向海外跨公网链路的韧性层。版本：0.4.0 · 许可：MPL-2.0 · 平台：Android、iOS
data.三通道分离绝不混用#三通道分离，绝不混用:
媒体    WebRTC（WHIP/WHEP 或 LiveKit）  视频 / 音频 / 屏幕
控制    MQTT 或 DataChannel            遥控指令、PTZ、遥测、设备信令
业务    HTTPS                          令牌、设备绑定、OTA 分发、报告归档
三条通道各自独立降级：网络变差时先降视频，再降音频，控制指令最后才降。
data.双引擎统一抽象#双引擎，统一抽象:
WHIP/WHEP 引擎	LiveKit 引擎	底层包	flutter_webrtc	livekit_client	适用	自建 SRS / ZLMediaKit / MediaMTX、IoT 摄像头播放	互动房间、连麦、大并发围观	信令	HTTP（RFC 9725）	LiveKit 服务端 + JWT	重协商	禁止——改用 replaceTrack，ICE 重启时重建	支持	
两者暴露同一套接口：RtcEngine → RtcSession → LocalPublisher /
RemoteSubscriber，共享 RtcEvent 事件流与 RtcStats。
data.能力一览#能力一览: 领域	入口	推流（摄像头 / 麦克风 / 屏幕、simulcast）	LocalPublisher	订阅与清晰度切换	RemoteSubscriber、VideoGridController	直播转接与角色交接	RoleTransfer、StreamRelay	机器人远控	RobotController、TeleopChannel	设备配网、OTA、日志、诊断	DeviceProvisioning、OtaUpdater、DeviceLogCollector、Diagnostics	权限	RtcPermissions	韧性（海外、切网、弱网、后台）	ResilientSession、RelayPlanner、NetworkPathMonitor、MediaHealthMonitor、PauseResumeGate
data.从这里开始#从这里开始:
安装 —— 添加依赖与平台配置
快速开始 —— 第一条推拉流链路
韧性 —— 出海前必读
机器人远控 —— 摇杆、看门狗与暂停恢复流程
设备管理 —— 配网、OTA、日志、诊断
常见问题 —— 平台差异与踩坑
英文文档见站点的根路径（右上角可返回 English。

data.从-github-安装#从 GitHub 安装:
dependencies:
  flutter_rtc_link:
    git:
      url: https://github.com/zero-labsco/flutter_rtc_link.git
      ref: release/v0.4.0
data.导入#导入:
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link.dart'; // 媒体核心
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link_device.dart'; // 配网、OTA、日志
import 'package:flutter_rtc_link/flutter_rtc_link_robot.dart'; // 机器人遥控
按需导入所需模块即可：媒体核心、设备管理与机器人遥控是彼此独立的入口。所有公开
API 都由这三个文件之一再导出，不要直接导入 lib/src/...。
data.环境要求#环境要求: 要求	版本	Flutter	>= 3.35.0	Dart SDK	>= 3.9.0 < 4.0.0	Android	minSdk 24，compileSdk 36+	iOS	15.0+
data.android-配置#Android 配置:
以下权限会由插件合并进宿主 manifest，通常无需手写：
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />

data.下一步#下一步:
快速开始
韧性 —— 部署到公网前必读

data.换采集源而不重协商#换采集源而不重协商:
WHIP（RFC 9725）禁止在初始 SDP 之后修改 media section，因此插件从不重协商，
换轨一律用 replaceTrack：
await publisher.switchCamera(facing: CameraFacing.front); // 无 ICE、无 SDP
await publisher.startScreenShare();                        // 只创建一次 sender
await publisher.stopScreenShare();                         // 回到摄像头
:::tip
保持 sender 常驻、只换轨道。每次切换都新建/关闭 sender 正是 WHIP 服务端出现
"一秒黑屏"的原因。
:::
data.simulcast#Simulcast:
服务端支持时，推流始终开启多层：
maxClarity	发布的层	p2160	2160p / 1080p / 540p	p1080	1080p / 720p / 360p	p720	720p / 360p	p360	360p	
setPublishClarity 只升降最高层，低层始终保留，因此订阅端不会因为发布端的
选择而受限。
await publisher.setPublishClarity(ClarityLevel.p720); // 限制，不重启
data.结束#结束:
await publisher.stop();  // 停轨道，会话仍在
await session.leave();   // 彻底拆掉

data.5-让它扛得住真实网络#5. 让它扛得住真实网络:
再加一步即可把会话升级为受控、自愈的链路：
final resilient = await ResilientSession.connect(
  roomId: 'robot-42',
  role: RtcRole.robotOperator,
  factory: engine.join,
  config: ResilientSessionConfig(
    relay: RelayPlanner(servers: iceServers),
    monitor: CallbackNetworkMonitor(),
  ),
);
详见 韧性。
data.离开会话#离开会话:
await resilient.dispose(); // 或 await session.leave();
await engine.dispose();

data.选择控制通道#选择控制通道:
final selection = ControlLinkRouter(rttBudgetMs: 200).select(paths);
通道	适用	ControlLinkKind.dataChannel	首选——随 WebRTC 连接走，约 12ms	ControlLinkKind.mqtt	跨公网 / 跨区域回退，约 180ms	
路由器还会报告所选路径是否在 rttBudgetMs 预算内，让 UI 在操作员开动之前就给出
提示。若机器人侧完全不走网络，可用 BleTeleopChannel.forDevice(device)——第四个
TeleopChannel，走持久的 BLE GATT 链路（用 BleTeleopDiscoverer 扫描）。它也能作为
DualTeleopChannel 的 secondary，即使网络断了，停车指令仍能源达机器人：
final channel = DualTeleopChannel(
  primary: DataChannelTeleopChannel(...),   // 或 MqttTeleopChannel
  secondary: BleTeleopChannel.forDevice(device),
);
GATT 契约详见蓝牙遥测控制。

data.切换清晰度#切换清晰度:
await remote.setClarity(ClarityLevel.p540); // 只影响这一路
await session.unsubscribe('robot-42');
引擎	单层流	多层 / 变体流	LiveKit	videoQuality 直接映射	原生选层	WHIP/WHEP	无法软切换——插件改为切换变体流 id（_sd / _hd / _fhd，1~2s 闪断）或上报 claritySwitchUnsupported	SDP rid 选层	
:::warning
单层流没有软件清晰度切换能力。要么在服务端转码（ZLMediaKit），要么把主/子码流
暴露为不同 stream id——插件绝不会假装能切。
:::
data.auto-模式#auto 模式:
auto 跟随 RtcStats：可用带宽、丢包与 RTT 共同决定升降层，而
remote.clarity.value 始终反映当前实际档位，UI 不会说谎。

data:
A link that works in the office LAN fails differently on the public internet —
especially across borders. This page is the whole point of the plugin's
lib/src/resilience/ layer.
data.failure-modes-you-only-meet-outside-the-: Situation	LAN behaviour	Public-internet behaviour	Connect	Succeeds first try	First SDP round trip can take 5–15 s, or time out silently	NAT	STUN is enough	CGNAT, hotel Wi-Fi, symmetric NAT, lossy cross-border paths	Handover	Rare	Wi-Fi ↔ cellular repeatedly, IP changes while the socket looks alive	Weak network	Stable bandwidth	Loss and jitter; RTT climbs from 60 ms to 600 ms+	Frozen picture	—	Still "connected", fps drops to 0	Background	—	Android/iOS reclaim or downgrade the app at any time	Reconnect	Instant	Flapping link, infinite retry storm, duplicated commands
data.wrap-your-session#Wrap your session:
final monitor = CallbackNetworkMonitor(); // feed it from connectivity_plus
final resilient = await ResilientSession.connect(
  roomId: 'robot-42',
  role: RtcRole.robotOperator,
  factory: engine.join,
  config: ResilientSessionConfig(
    policy: const LinkPolicy(
      connectTimeout: Duration(seconds: 12),
      reconnect: ReconnectPolicy(maxAttempts: 8, relayAfterAttempts: 2),
      restartIceOnHandover: true,
    ),
    relay: RelayPlanner(servers: iceServers, preferredRegions: <String>['ap']),
    monitor: monitor,
  ),
);
data.link-phases#Link phases:
resilient.health exposes a LinkHealth with a LinkPhase:idle → connecting → connected （或 degraded）→ reconnecting → connected / faileddegraded means "connected, but the media is stuttering or congested" — the UI
must not show a green "connected" LED in that state.
data.connection-establishment#Connection esta:
LinkPolicy.connectTimeout bounds the first attempt; a failed connect
rethrows an RtcException instead of hanging.
Retries are supervised by ReconnectSupervisor with jittered exponential
backoff (jitterRatio), so a fleet of devices does not retry in lockstep.
stableWindow protects against flapping: a link that fails again shortly
after coming up does not reset the attempt counter, otherwise it could
never escalate to relay.
final delay = supervisor.scheduleNext();   // null once the budget is gone
supervisor.recordFailure();                // or recordSuccess()
data.network-switching#Network switching:
monitor.update(NetworkPath(kind: NetworkKind.cellular, generation: 7, metered: true));
NetworkPath carries a generation so a same-kind roam (Wi-Fi → another
Wi-Fi) is distinguishable from a real handover:
Change	requiresIceRestart()	Wi-Fi → cellular	true	Wi-Fi → none	false (the link is paused, there is nothing to restart)	Wi-Fi → another Wi-Fi	false by default, true with restartOnSameKind: true	
On a real handover the session calls IceRestartable.restartIce(). WHIP/WHEP
cannot renegotiate (RFC 9725), so the peer connection is rebuilt with a
fresh ICE configuration — including relay when TURN is forced.
data.reconnect#Reconnect:
The dead session is torn down before the backoff starts — no orphaned timers.
Every remembered stream is re-subscribed, with its last clarity.
Control operations stay invalidated until the resume is confirmed (below).
data.pause--resume-never-replay-an-expired-op:
pause(reason)
   └── epoch++ → every in-flight and buffered operation is now stale
   └── robot stops immediately (RobotController.pause sends stop, disarms watchdog)
requestResume()  → ResumeTicket(epoch = next, expires)
confirmResume(ticket) → checks: paused? same ticket? not expired?
   └── true  → epoch advances, only freshly stamped operations run
   └── false → reason reported ("no ticket issued" / "ticket expired" / "ticket mismatch")
final gate = PauseResumeGate();
final queue = EpochOperationQueue<Velocity>(gate);
queue.submit(const Velocity(linear: 0.6)); // epoch 1
gate.pause(PauseReason.background);        // epoch 2 — everything older is stale
final ticket = gate.requestResume();       // bound to epoch 3, expires
if (gate.confirmResume(ticket)) {
  queue.take();                            // null → dropped, NOT replayed
}
final gate2 = queue.gate;
debugPrint('dropped ${gate2.discardedOperations}');
Rules the plugin enforces:
Operations produced while suspended are dropped and counted, never
buffered for a later replay.
RobotController's keepalive re-checks the epoch, so a pre-pause velocity
can never be replayed.
Resuming needs a human confirmation, or an explicit
resumeImmediately(afterReconnect: true) policy decision.
data.checklist-before-shipping#Checklist befo:
TURN deployed and reachable from outside your office network.
preferredRegions matches where your devices actually are.
setBackground wired to the app lifecycle.
Resume confirmation wired to a real UI action, not to a timer.
health.phase == degraded renders a warning, not a green LED.

data:
办公室局域网能跑通的链路，到了公网——尤其是跨境——会暴露出完全不同的失败模式。
本页即插件 lib/src/resilience/ 模块存在的全部理由。
data.只有出海才会遇到的失败模式#只有出海才会遇到的失败模式: 场景	局域网表现	公网表现	连接建立	一次成功	首次 SDP 往返可能 5~15s，甚至静默超时	NAT 穿越	STUN 足够	CGNAT、酒店 Wi-Fi、对称型 NAT、跨境丢包	网络切换	几乎不发生	Wi-Fi ↔ 蜂窝反复切换，IP 变了但 socket 看着还活着	弱网	带宽稳定	丢包抖动，RTT 从 60ms 涨到 600ms+	画面冻结	—	仍显示"已连接"，但 fps 掉到 0	后台	—	Android / iOS 随时回收或降权	断线重连	秒级恢复	抖动链路反复上下线，重连风暴与指令重复
data.包一层即可#包一层即可:
final monitor = CallbackNetworkMonitor(); // 由 connectivity_plus 喂数据
final resilient = await ResilientSession.connect(
  roomId: 'robot-42',
  role: RtcRole.robotOperator,
  factory: engine.join,
  config: ResilientSessionConfig(
    policy: const LinkPolicy(
      connectTimeout: Duration(seconds: 12),
      reconnect: ReconnectPolicy(maxAttempts: 8, relayAfterAttempts: 2),
      restartIceOnHandover: true,
    ),
    relay: RelayPlanner(servers: iceServers, preferredRegions: <String>['ap']),
    monitor: monitor,
  ),
);
data.链路阶段#链路阶段: resilient.health 返回带 LinkPhase 的 LinkHealth：idle → connecting → connected（或 degraded）→ reconnecting → connected / faileddegraded 表示"连着，但媒体在卡顿或拥塞"——UI 绝不能在这一状态下亮绿灯。
data.连接建立#连接建立:
LinkPolicy.connectTimeout 约束首次尝试；失败抛出 RtcException 而不是挂起。
重试由 ReconnectSupervisor 管控，带抖动的指数退避（jitterRatio），
避免一整批设备同时重试。
stableWindow 防止抖动：刚起来又断的链路不会重置尝试计数，否则永远升不到
中继。
final delay = supervisor.scheduleNext(); // 预算耗尽后返回 null
supervisor.recordFailure();              // 或 recordSuccess()
data.网络切换#网络切换:
monitor.update(NetworkPath(kind: NetworkKind.cellular, generation: 7, metered: true));
NetworkPath 带 generation，因此能区分"同类型漫游"与"真正换链"：
变化	requiresIceRestart()	Wi-Fi → 蜂窝	true	Wi-Fi → 无网络	false（链路被暂停，没有可重启的对象）	Wi-Fi → 另一个 Wi-Fi	默认 false；restartOnSameKind: true 时为 true	
真正的换链会调用 IceRestartable.restartIce()。WHIP/WHEP 不支持重协商
（RFC 9725），因此这里用全新的 ICE 配置重建 peer connection——强制 TURN 时
带 relay。
data.断线重连#断线重连:
退避开始前先拆掉死会话——不留孤立定时器；
重新订阅每一路记住的流，并恢复其最后的清晰度；
控制操作在恢复被确认之前保持失效（见下）。
data.暂停--恢复绝不补发过期操作#暂停 / 恢复：绝不补发过期操作:
pause(reason)
   └── epoch++ → 所有在飞与缓存操作立即过期
   └── 机器人立即停车（RobotController.pause 发 stop 并撤防看门狗）
requestResume()  → ResumeTicket(epoch = 下一个, 会过期)
confirmResume(ticket) → 校验：已暂停？票据一致？未过期？
   └── true  → epoch 落定，只有新盖戳的操作才会执行
   └── false → 上报原因（"no ticket issued" / "ticket expired" / "ticket mismatch"）
final gate = PauseResumeGate();
final queue = EpochOperationQueue<Velocity>(gate);
queue.submit(const Velocity(linear: 0.6)); // epoch 1
gate.pause(PauseReason.background);        // epoch 2：此前一切过期
final ticket = gate.requestResume();       // 绑定 epoch 3，会过期
if (gate.confirmResume(ticket)) {
  queue.take();                            // null → 已丢弃，不是补发
}
debugPrint('已丢弃 ${queue.gate.discardedOperations} 条');
插件强制执行的三条规则：
暂停期间产生的操作一律丢弃并计数，绝不缓存到恢复后补发；
RobotController 的保活每拍都重新校验 epoch，暂停前的速度无法溜过去；
恢复必须由人确认，或由策略显式调用 resumeImmediately(afterReconnect: true)。
data.出海前自检#出海前自检:
TURN 已部署，且从公司外网可达；
preferredRegions 与设备实际所在区域一致；
setBackground 已接到应用生命周期；
恢复确认接的是真实 UI 动作，而不是定时器；
health.phase == degraded 渲染为告警，而不是绿灯。
